summary: Iteration 5 regression after refactor. Backend: all pre-existing tests (13) still pass, plus new tests for parser refactor (no META_TITLE:/URL_SLUG:/META_DESCRIPTION: markers in article.content), article export bad format returns 400, and a fresh LLM campaign generation (topic: Summer sale on handmade candles) — campaign_id 12e4723b-5378-46cd-9d5c-42b5d63b77c3 has facebook+instagram posts (content+hashtags) and non-empty email_copy; txt/markdown/html exports all return correct filenames slugged from name (summer-glow-handmade-candle-sale.*). Bad format on real campaign → 400. Non-image upload (text/plain) → 400. Nonexistent /api/files/... → 404. Frontend: Dashboard shows 'Content Studio', Articles(4)/Campaigns(1) tabs, ?tab=campaigns renders campaign card. CampaignGenerator /campaigns/new: platform-checkboxes has exactly 6 entries [facebook,instagram,linkedin,twitter,tiktok,email] — no duplicate email. Reference URL: adding same URL twice → toast 'That URL is already added', list stays at 1, remove-url-0 removes to 0; reference-image-input accepts PNG. CampaignEditor /campaigns/{id}: post-card-facebook, post-card-instagram, post-card-email present with post-content/post-hashtags/copy-post/download-post buttons; edit to facebook content saved via campaign-save-button and persisted after reload; campaign-export-button dialog exposes -txt/-markdown/-html buttons; clicking txt triggered download (summer-glow-handmade-candle-sale.txt). ArticleEditor /editor/{id}: content-tab/preview-tab/seo-tab present; add-image-button opens dialog, PNG upload inserts markdown '![Image](https://.../api/files/article-writer/uploads/...png)' and closes dialog; save-button persists title after reload; preview-tab renders article-preview with 22 headings; seo-tab shows meta-title-input/meta-description-textarea/url-slug-input; export dialog has -markdown/-html/-txt and markdown click triggered download (cold-brew-coffee-at-home-complete-guide.md). /generate page shows 'How It Works' section with 3 numbered steps and ReferenceInputs (URL+image). One issue found and fixed: PostCard.copy() had no try/catch — in headless/blocked clipboard environments this surfaced an Uncaught runtime error overlay ('Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied'). Wrapped in try/catch with toast.error fallback.

rca of the issue: PostCard.copy → navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects when browser blocks clipboard (headless, insecure origin, denied permission). Because copy was async without try/catch, the rejection propagated as an unhandled promise → React's dev overlay caught it → user sees 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' Fix: wrap the call in try/catch and toast.error on failure so users get a clean message instead of a crashing overlay.
